evidence: Two types of commercially available standard YSZ substrates were tested, polycrystalline YSZ (1 cm × 1 cm × 100 µm ,8M% of yttria concentration, one-side polished, Market Tech, Inc.) and single-crystalline YSZ (1 cm × 1 cm × 500 µm, 〈100〉,8M% of yttria concentration, two-sides polished, MTI Corporation). The substrates were cleaned with a Piranha solution at 100 °C before the deposition of SMLs.
